name: Portable robot
devices_driven: guide catheter 5-9 F (5 F and 8 F tested) and guidewire 0.33-1 mm (0.36 mm and 0.89 mm tested)
translation_detail: other: guide catheter on 1.5 mm-pitch lead-screw platform (300 mm range); guidewire by active friction roller plus spring-loaded passive roller, range > 1200 mm
rotation_detail: guide catheter: BLDC motor with 2:1 spur gears (360 deg); guidewire: commercial torque device on motor gear train (360 deg)
device_range: catheter 5-9 F; wire 0.33-1 mm (abstract: 1-9 F; text: clamp for 0.33-3 mm)
footprint_mm: 250 x 350 x 250 (abstract; LegoBot Table I writes 360 x 250 x 250)
force_sensing: motor current; external load cell in bench tests only
sterility: N.R. (cartridge for sterilisation proposed in discussion)
validation_detail: benchtop tracking with motion capture; force/torque tests (2 catheters, 2 wires); guidewire advanced to left coronary ostium in a 3D-printed human-heart phantom with EM tracker (one demonstration)
key_numbers: peak force 5.49 N (8 F), 3.44 N (5 F), wire 0.38/0.35 N; peak torque 10.61/6.55 mN.m (8F/5F), wire 0.42/0.22 mN.m; tracking RMSE 10.3 deg and 0.31 mm; wire deviation ~6.9 deg / 0.9 mm; 90% smaller than CorPath (1780x690x1170 mm)
